text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This autumn, Rulership not only conquered 
both the spring and autumn Grand Prix 
races, but also established another grand 
record.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rulership achieves the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown! She is only the third 
Umamusume in history to do so!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
People said her starts were an issue, but 
she's blown those rumors clean away!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ho, right on our heels, are you? Not bad 
at all, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was truly magnificent...! 'The 
strategist thus becomes a hero,' indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"A glorious double trophy, huh? Not bad. 
Not bad at all, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“—The Autumn Senior Triple Crown. It's 
notoriously difficult to claim... Truly a 
platinum trophy.”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... But behind almost every remarkable 
feat, there is a "reason."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There was a groundwork laid for winning 
the Fall Senior Triple Crown. What do you 
think it was?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So you don't remember after all. Well, it 
was just small talk, so it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
See, I told you about it before, didn't I? 
About that "nightmare" on a certain summer 
night.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is terrible... I had the 
worst nightmare...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream where I was forced to take a 
"starting gate re-test"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Starting gate re-examination. A re-test 
imposed on Umamusume with extremely poor 
starts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether she can break from the gate 
properly. Just like a pre-debut Umamusume, 
she is re-tested at Tracen Academy, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This autumn's GIs. A late start in every 
single one, ending in defeat. And yet in 
my dream, for some reason, the place where 
the test was held was...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't Tracen Academy, but the 
racetrack. Almost as if being put on 
display for public humiliation before the 
fans...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a dream. This is only a dream... And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"What will you do if your dream comes 
true? Will a retest... be inevitable?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a test in public view. It sounds 
unthinkable, but if it were to actually 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to humiliate them, but if I 
refuse, we can't race. Accept it or 
retire... If this really is the ultimate 
dilemma...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even so... what if you had no choice but 
to choose?
choice_data_list: There's no way I could choose...
There's no way I could choose...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweat of anguish glistens on her brow... I 
don't want her pride wounded, nor do I 
want her forced into retirement—never...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see... You really care that much about 
me...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Understood—in that case...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That incident in the dream was the reason 
for stepping up.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I must never, ever force a painful choice 
upon you. If that is the case—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—All that's left is to win everything and 
silence them with results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Rulership used her nightmare to 
her advantage to pull off this incredible 
feat.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, I'd rather not take 
the gate re-test in front of fans, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, I was thinking of putting on a 
special event for the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That event took place at the 
racetrack—after the final race had 
concluded."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Today, to celebrate 
Rulership-san winning the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
We will now hold a special exhibition 
match of "Reversi"!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The opponent is none other than my best 
friend and comrade-in-arms, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The partner with whom she devised 
brilliant strategies now becomes her 
rival!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... To think the day would come when 
I'd compete against you before a crowd of 
race fans.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —We really made it to the top, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It used to be just the two of us playing 
online matches. Now, it's become an entire 
show.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Still, I feel a bit reluctant to 
pick on a Trainer of your caliber in front 
of your fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership is certainly the strongest board 
gamer. However...
choice_data_list:
No holding back! Because I'm not gonna 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... confident! I see, winning the Fall 
Senior Triple Crown gave you a huge boost 
in confidence too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us begin. Normally, a Reversi 
board is divided into black and white, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall dye everything in my own 
color. Now, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A multitude of white stars shining upon 
the board. Thus, Rulership erased the 
darkness etched into her destiny.
